event_text: An attacker accesses a LALIGA fan-services platform and extracts personal data, per LALIGA
notes: Dates as given by LALIGA; no times stated.

event_text: LALIGA applies measures to contain the attack, stop the extraction and block the attacker
notes: Per LALIGA; Reuters says LALIGA became aware of the attack on this date.

event_text: LALIGA learns of the incident, per CD Eldense; Reuters gives Nov 16
notes: Per CD Eldense's statement as reported by Cadena SER.

event_text: LALIGA publishes its statement; Reuters and Europa Press report it the same day
notes: Date as published by the three sources.

event_text: Clubs including Getafe CF, Real Oviedo, Girona FC and Albacete Balompié tell their fans their data is among that taken
notes: Real Oviedo dates its statement Nov 23; the others give no date and followed LALIGA's statement.
